feature:component:add.title: Component Addition Checklist
items: Update documentation
Run 'make pnpm clean' and 'make pnpm build' at the end of development

feature:page:add.title: New Page Addition Checklist
items: Add the link in the Links.ts file
Add metadata
Add the corresponding JSON.LD to the page (Using JsonLd component and DynamicJsonLd component with schema-dts library)
Update the sitemap
Readable page elements must use locale and be present in [fr.json] and [en.json] files
Verify responsive page behavior (using tailwind)
Run 'make pnpm clean' and 'make pnpm build' at the end of development

feature:news:add.title: News Addition Checklist
items: Update documentation
Spell check
News must be in French and English in their respective directories with appropriate names
Verify tag names

feature:api:add.title: API Route Addition Checklist
items: Set up exception reporting in the appropriate log
Implement API unavailability handling
Use zod for data mapping
Run 'make pnpm clean' and 'make pnpm build' at the end of development

feature:color:add.title: CSS Color Addition Checklist
items: Check if the color doesn't already exist in the global.css file
Reference the color as a variable in the global.css file
Run 'make pnpm clean' and 'make pnpm build' at the end of development

feature:lib:add.title: Library Addition Checklist
items: Update documentation
Check for known CVEs
